title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
summary: OpenAI 预览其新的 API 服务层级 Ultrafast，该层级通过 Cerebras 技术支持 GPT-5.6 Sol 模型，运行速度提升至原来的 14 倍，输出速度可达每秒 750 个 token。
highlights: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster.
Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.
